_comment: Worked example for Financopedia. The company and all figures are INVENTED — replace every one, and replace every source and basis string with the real filing you took the figure from. The builder refuses to run if any source or basis is missing, and requires 7-12 years of history.

sources.revenue: FY2016-FY2025 audited accounts in the draft prospectus, dated 2026-09-30 (revenue)
sources.ebitda: FY2016-FY2025 audited accounts in the draft prospectus, dated 2026-09-30 (ebitda)
sources.net_income: FY2016-FY2025 audited accounts in the draft prospectus, dated 2026-09-30 (net_income)

basis.rev_growth: Prospectus forecast, cross-checked against the 10-year CAGR
basis.ebitda_margin: ESTIMATE: held near FY2025, inside the 10-year range
basis.net_margin: ESTIMATE: FY2025 net margin carried forward
basis.ipo_discount: ESTIMATE: 10-15% is the customary IPO discount; midpoint taken
basis.primary_proceeds_target: Primary raise stated in the draft prospectus
basis.secondary_shares: Selling shareholder shares per the draft prospectus
basis.pre_ipo_shares: Share capital per the FY2025 audited accounts
basis.underwriting_fee_pct: Gross spread in the underwriting agreement
basis.other_offering_costs: Listing, legal and audit costs per the prospectus
basis.greenshoe_pct: Over-allotment option in the underwriting agreement
basis.net_debt: Total debt less cash, FY2025 balance sheet
basis.price_range_pct: Marketing range width per the bookrunners' proposal
basis.weight_ev_sales: Secondary check; least weight given margin dispersion
basis.weight_pe: Relevant because the company is already profitable
